## Summary
Build the exam-taking UI: a countdown timer bar, a navigation panel with item status indicators (answered, flagged, unanswered), and the question view container that renders one item at a time.

## User story
As a student taking an exam, I want to see a countdown timer and a navigation panel showing which questions I've answered or flagged, so that I can manage my time and review flagged items before submitting.

## Why this matters
Without a timer, students have no time awareness and may be surprised by auto-submission. Without navigation, students cannot jump to unanswered questions or review flagged items. Both are standard exam delivery features required for LCME-accredited assessments.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] ExamTimerBar shows countdown from expires_at, updates every second
- [ ] Timer turns yellow at 5 minutes remaining, red at 1 minute remaining
- [ ] ExamNavPanel shows grid of item numbers with status: unanswered (gray), answered (green), flagged (orange)
- [ ] Clicking an item number in nav panel jumps to that question
- [ ] Student can flag/unflag current question (toggle, persists in local state)
- [ ] "Review flagged" button filters nav to show only flagged items
- [ ] Previous/Next buttons navigate sequentially through items
- [ ] useExamSession hook manages current position, flags, answer state
- [ ] Timer reaching 0 triggers auto-submit warning (actual submit is E07-S08)

## Code patterns to follow
```typescript
// features/exam-delivery/hooks/useExamSession.ts
'use client';
import { useState, useEffect, useCallback, useRef } from 'react';
import { createBrowserClient } from '@journey/db/client';
import type { Row } from '@journey/db/client';

type SessionItem = Row<'session_items'>;

interface ExamSessionState {
  sessionId: string;
  items: SessionItem[];
  currentIndex: number;
  flagged: Set<string>;
  answers: Map<string, string>;
  expiresAt: Date;
  timeRemaining: number; // seconds
}

export function useExamSession(sessionId: string) {
  const [state, setState] = useState<ExamSessionState | null>(null);
  const intervalRef = useRef<NodeJS.Timeout | null>(null);

  // Timer countdown
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!state?.expiresAt) return;
    intervalRef.current = setInterval(() => {
      const remaining = Math.max(0, Math.floor((state.expiresAt.getTime() - Date.now()) / 1000));
      setState(prev => prev ? { ...prev, timeRemaining: remaining } : null);
    }, 1000);
    return () => { if (intervalRef.current) clearInterval(intervalRef.current); };
  }, [state?.expiresAt]);

  const goToItem = useCallback((index: number) => {
    setState(prev => prev ? { ...prev, currentIndex: index } : null);
  }, []);

  const toggleFlag = useCallback((itemId: string) => {
    setState(prev => {
      if (!prev) return null;
      const flagged = new Set(prev.flagged);
      if (flagged.has(itemId)) flagged.delete(itemId);
      else flagged.add(itemId);
      return { ...prev, flagged };
    });
  }, []);

  return { state, goToItem, toggleFlag };
}

// features/exam-delivery/components/ExamTimerBar.tsx
'use client';
import { cn } from '@/shared/utils/cn';

interface ExamTimerBarProps {
  timeRemaining: number; // seconds
}

export function ExamTimerBar({ timeRemaining }: ExamTimerBarProps) {
  const minutes = Math.floor(timeRemaining / 60);
  const seconds = timeRemaining % 60;
  const isWarning = timeRemaining <= 300; // 5 min
  const isCritical = timeRemaining <= 60;  // 1 min

  return (
    <div className={cn(
      'px-4 py-2 text-lg font-mono rounded',
      isCritical ? 'bg-red-100 text-red-800' :
      isWarning ? 'bg-yellow-100 text-yellow-800' :
      'bg-gray-100 text-gray-800'
    )}>
      {String(minutes).padStart(2, '0')}:{String(seconds).padStart(2, '0')}
    </div>
  );
}
```

## Automated tests (Playwright — runs during /validate)
```typescript
// tests/E07/E07-S04.ui.test.ts
import { test, expect } from '@playwright/test';

test('Exam page shows timer counting down', async ({ page }) => {
  // Navigate to active exam session
  await page.goto('/exam/test-session-id');
  const timer = page.getByTestId('exam-timer');
  await expect(timer).toBeVisible();
  const text1 = await timer.textContent();
  await page.waitForTimeout(2000);
  const text2 = await timer.textContent();
  expect(text1).not.toBe(text2); // Timer is counting down
});

test('Navigation panel shows all items with status indicators', async ({ page }) => {
  await page.goto('/exam/test-session-id');
  const navPanel = page.getByTestId('exam-nav-panel');
  await expect(navPanel).toBeVisible();
  // Should have numbered buttons for each item
  const buttons = navPanel.getByRole('button');
  expect(await buttons.count()).toBeGreaterThan(0);
});

test('Clicking nav item jumps to that question', async ({ page }) => {
  await page.goto('/exam/test-session-id');
  const navButton = page.getByTestId('nav-item-5');
  await navButton.click();
  const questionView = page.getByTestId('question-view');
  await expect(questionView).toContainText(/question 5/i);
});

test('Flag toggle marks question as flagged in nav panel', async ({ page }) => {
  await page.goto('/exam/test-session-id');
  const flagButton = page.getByTestId('flag-button');
  await flagButton.click();
  const navItem = page.getByTestId('nav-item-1');
  await expect(navItem).toHaveClass(/flagged/);
});
```
